image_urls.description: Stock market candlestick chart on dark screen for hero background and animated ticker

features: Animated landing screen with candlestick graph and dearAnalyst brand
Spreadsheet .xlsx and .csv upload with instant column preview
Multi-page story builder with add/delete/reorder pages
Chart type selection (Candlestick, Line, Bar, Area, Scatter, Pie/Donut, Radar, Composed, Histogram, Heatmap, Waterfall, Bubble, Funnel, Box Plot, Sparkline)
Field mapping (X-axis, Y-axis, Open, High, Low, Close, Volume)
Axis naming and Chart title customization
Interactive tooltips, mousehover features, zoom, gridlines, and crosshairs
Analyst notes side-box for financial storytelling narrative on every page
Save and continue page flow with persistent storage
Global and page-level download actions for Shareable HTML Story, PDF, and PowerPoint .pptx
